name: Lens
author: Erin Carter
description: Three large invisible lens blobs roam a faint dark field, magnifying and smearing the dim wisps behind them while a hairline palette-tinted rim ignites at each lens edge. Light bends instead of emitting — the subject is distortion itself, sloshing at the pace of shallow water.

params.label: Lens size
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of each lens blob, from palm-sized ripples to frame-dominating swells.

params.label: Roam speed
params.effect: Speed of the Lissajous drift paths the lenses wander along.

params.label: Refraction
params.effect: Displacement strength — how strongly the background magnifies and smears through each lens, with rim brightness scaling to match.
